statement: The replica-operation repository decodes the durable membership_publication_epoch column through one binding owner: SQL NULL or an absent column rehydrates as an unbound operation that dispatches under the existing unbound rule, a persisted non-negative integer (including zero) rehydrates as exactly that bound epoch and keeps the stale-bound rejection and current-bound acceptance, malformed durable values fail closed with a typed error, and every behavior-changing reader of the operation's membership epoch consumes that single decode with no local numeric reinterpretation.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The durable-to-semantic decode of membership_publication_epoch lives in exactly one module and every behavior-changing reader consumes it; no reader may locally reinterpret the field with Number(), parseInt, Math.*, or a ?? 0 / || 0 sentinel.
SQL NULL and an absent column decode to UNBOUND; integer 0 decodes to BOUND 0; the two are never collapsed in either direction.
Any durable representation outside {NULL, absent, non-negative integer} fails closed with a typed error and is never coerced into an epoch.

The dispatch stale-epoch policy (unbound passes, unreadable current defers, mismatch fails closed, match passes), the current-membership epoch owner, the topology settling gate, and Quest 2 planning generation are not changed by this Quest.
